تستظهرون (form X)
# تَسْتَظْهِرُونَ (tastaẓhirūna) /tas.taðˤ.hi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَظْهَرَ (istaẓhara)
# تُسْتَظْهَرُونَ (tustaẓharūna) /tus.taðˤ.ha.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَظْهَرَ (istaẓhara)
